text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government says it will soon start exposing perpetrators of misinformation about Zambia who write misleading reports published abroad, deputy information minister Ernest Mwansa said.
- Japan has provided a 830 million yen grant for the rehabilitation of roads in western Zambia.
- Eight refugees from Zaire and Burundi have been arrested for being in possession of firearms, officials said.
- Deputy President Godfrey Miyanda says government is to start censoring television programmes.
